verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents a Customer Agent API page where customer requests come in through the API instead of a ticketing system. The changelog also says the Internal Agent can be run from your own tools via the API, so programmatic driving is a first-party capability. However, the evidence shows no endpoint reference, auth scheme or request/response schema, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so how deep and broad the API goes is unproven. Missing for 10: endpoint/reference documentation, published OpenAPI spec, auth and SDK details, evidence of coverage beyond request intake and running tasks, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
